skills.name: Votive Incense
skills.desc: Deals Fire DMG equal to #1[i]% of Lingsha's ATK to one designated enemy target.

skills.name: Smoke and Splendor
skills.desc: Deals Fire DMG equal to #1[i]% of Lingsha's ATK to all enemies and at the same time, restores HP equal to #2[f1]% of Lingsha's ATK plus #3[i] for all allies. Fuyuan's action advances by #4[i]%.

skills.name: Dripping Mistscape
skills.desc:
Inflicts "Befog" on all enemies. While in "Befog," targets receive #4[i]% increased Break DMG, lasting for #5[i] turn(s).
Deals Fire DMG equal to #1[i]% of Lingsha's ATK to all enemies, and at the same time restores HP equal to #2[f1]% of Lingsha's ATK plus #3[i] for all allies. Fuyuan's action advances by #6[i]%.

skills.name: Mistdance Manifest
skills.desc:
When using Skill, summons "Fuyuan," with an initial SPD of #1[i] and an initial action count of #7[i].
When taking action, "Fuyuan" launches Follow-Up ATK, dealing Fire DMG equal to #2[i]% of Lingsha's ATK to all enemies. Additionally deals Fire DMG equal to #8[i]% of Lingsha's ATK to one random enemy, and this DMG prioritizes targets that have both Toughness greater than 0 and Fire Weakness. Dispels #6[i] debuff(s) from all allies and restores HP equal to #3[f1]% of Lingsha's ATK plus #4[i].
"Fuyuan's" action count can accumulate up to #5[i]. When the action count reaches 0 or when Lingsha is knocked down, "Fuyuan" disappears.
While "Fuyuan" is on the field, using Skill can increase "Fuyuan's" action count by #7[i].

skills.name: Wisps of Aurora
skills.desc: After using Technique, immediately summons Fuyuan at the start of the next battle and inflicts "Befog" on all enemies, lasting for #1[i] turn(s).

passives.name: Vermilion Waft
passives.desc: Increases this unit's ATK or Outgoing Healing by an amount equal to 25%/10% of Break Effect, up to a maximum increase of 50%/20% respectively.

passives.name: Sylvan Smoke
passives.desc: When using Basic ATK, additionally regenerates 10 Energy.

passives.name: Ember's Echo
passives.desc: While "Fuyuan" is on the field and any ally character takes DMG or consumes HP, if a character in the team has their current HP percentage lower than or equal to 60%, "Fuyuan" will immediately launch the Talent's Follow-Up ATK against enemies. This does not consume Fuyuan's action count. This effect can trigger again after 2 turn(s).
